page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower-to-mid tiers for compute and memory throughput. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth read speeds are similarly situated in the bottom 25%, though large block write bandwidth achieves average tier performance. Cryptographic and database operations, such as Redis SET and Passmark database tests, also register in the bottom 25%. However, the processor supports AVX and AVX-512 instruction sets, which helps maintain average performance in Passmark extended instruction tests and small-scale LLM inference tasks.

Given the high memory allocation relative to its processing power, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance compute or local storage IOPS. The lack of bundled local storage means it relies on network-attached storage, which aligns with its 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth. It is best suited for memory-heavy but compute-light applications, such as caching layers, small-scale database hosting, and lightweight middleware or enterprise applications that require a larger memory footprint without demanding high CPU cycles.
